name: HouseholdBudgetCalculator
tagline: Income and expense budget field for Power Pages forms (financial assistance, hardship, grant and membership applications) and model-driven/canvas apps.
description: Income and expense budget field for Power Pages forms (financial assistance, hardship, grant and membership applications) and model-driven/canvas apps. Configurable income and expense categories with hints and required items, per-line frequency (weekly to yearly) normalised to a chosen display period, custom extra lines, live totals, surplus/deficit status against an affordability threshold, an expense breakdown chart, validation, clear with undo, read-only and masked states and a stacked phone layout. Stores the budget as JSON.
